basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying highly performant, reliable, and scalable backend services and microservices. Expert in architectural design, automated testing, and fostering high-quality, maintainable code within cross-functional teams.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented highly performant and reliable Python-based event-driven microservices, processing 10M+ daily events with a focus on scalability and system integrity.
Standardized containerized deployments leveraging Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows to ensure consistent, reliable, and efficient delivery of software.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, setting high technical standards, fostering clean code practices, and enhancing overall team capabilities.
Developed custom internal toolchains, enhancing developer efficiency and reducing CI pipeline execution times by 40%.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust and scalable REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, ensuring high availability and secure data access.
Integrated third-party APIs and engineered automated webhook processors, facilitating seamless external developer interactions and data exchange.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of automated unit and integration tests, significantly raising coverage from 60% to 92% and improving overall system reliability.
